name: Later list tables stay clean
ownerWords:
review the tables behind the Later list in apps/chat (the later_* ones in chat.sqlite) and keep watching them
(dm_duty-check-1125201916d2-1 p1, 11-25, msg mwwkh7ri)
goal: The two chat.sqlite tables behind Later (later_principals and later_items, apps/chat/server/later-db.ts) hold only rows the server can read and someone needs. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/later-tables.ts) opens chat.sqlite read-only. While the week of JSON exports lasts, it compares each later/<by>.json with what LATER.dump renders from the rows, and it compares the owner's list the server serves with his rows. It counts rows that do not parse, whose id or by differs from the body, that miss a field LaterItem needs, that belong to no principal or that share an ord. It also counts rows of agents that are gone, of walks' test agents and of the owner's saves in walks' test rooms. A boot unsaves archived walks' items (later.ts dropWalkLeftovers), so a stale count that stays above 0 means a walk ended without archiving its room or agent.

metrics.label: later_items rows that do not parse, mismatch their row, lack a field, have no principal or share an ord
Later principals whose rows differ from their JSON export or from the list the server serves
later_items rows nobody reads: gone agents, walks' test agents and test rooms, gone rooms

onMiss: Each flag names a row as <by>/<id> and why it is flagged. For a stale owner row, unsave it through the server with curl -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:5184/api/later/<url-encoded id>. For a stale agent row whose agent still exists, unsave it with curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:5184/api/threads/<the agent's work thread>/later -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"message":"<room>/<post>","state":"removed"}'. A row of an archived walk goes at the next boot, so leave it. Never write to chat.sqlite by hand while the server runs. A bad row or drift is a bug in later-db.ts or later.ts: reproduce it in a test under apps/chat/test/server, fix the cause, and release with node scripts/release-apps-chat.mjs <sha>.
